color.$description:
The semantic colour layer for the dark theme.

This file defines exactly the same token names as themes/light.json — the build fails if the two ever diverge. Note the two structural inversions the dark theme makes: elevation reads as *lighter* surfaces rather than shadow, and interaction states step *up* the ramp (hover is lighter) instead of down.

canvas.$description: The page behind everything. Never put text directly on it without a surface.

surface.$description: Default raised content surface: cards, panels, sheets.

surfaceRaised.$description: A surface above another surface. Shadow barely reads on a dark canvas, so elevation is carried by lightness instead.

surfaceSunken.$description: A recessed well inside a surface: code blocks, inset lists, track backgrounds.

text.$description: Primary body and heading text. Not pure white — full-contrast white on a dark field haloes.

textMuted.$description: Secondary text: captions, help text, metadata.

textDisabled.$description: Text in a disabled control. Deliberately low contrast.

borderStrong.$description: Emphasised outline: hovered controls, active field borders.

focusRing.$description: Keyboard focus indicator. Lighter than the light theme's so it separates from the canvas.

shadow.$description: Elevation shadow colour. Much stronger than the light theme's: a soft shadow is invisible against a dark canvas, which is why the dark theme also steps surfaces lighter.

action.$description: The accent tone. Lighter than in the light theme so it carries dark foreground text.

onAction.$description: Dark foreground: the dark theme's action colour is a light fill.

neutral.$description: The neutral tone. Secondary buttons and low-emphasis fills.

positive.$description: The positive tone. Success, confirmation, safe-to-proceed.

warning.$description: The warning tone. Needs attention but is not an error.

critical.$description: The critical tone. Errors and destructive actions.
